Unknown Mortal Orchestra at Signal Kitchen

with Klaus Johann Grobe

  • Jul 23, 2016
  • Burlington, Vermont

The lo-fi, pillowy vibes from their recordings weren’t present live. They came off more broey and aggressive than I’d expected. Everything was played a little faster in this sweaty basement venue. I’d guess their audience spans several demographics, and tonight leaned rowdy.
